prerequisites: 1-INF-160 Introduction to combinatorics and graph theory

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with solid foundations of graph theory by proving key classical theorems and explaining the most important graph algorithms.
Understand motivation from other scientific disciplines and technology and possible applications of the covered topics.

syllabus_topics: Basic terminology: trees, bipartite graphs, graph and labyrinth search
Matchings in graphs, König's theorem, Hall theorem and its corollaries
Graph coloring: some NP-hard problems, greedy algorithm
Flows, Ford–Fulkerson algorithm and its applications
Integer and group flows, relationship to coloring
Random graphs, probabilistic models, properties of random graphs
assessment_rules: The approximate evaluation scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. Maximum 20% of the evaluation can be obtained by solving homeworks.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
